program_name: Transborder Chicana/o and Latina/o Studies, BA

programme_facts.value: The Bachelor of Arts program in transborder Chicana/o and Latina/o studies challenges you to understand the intersections of identity, culture and community for Mexican-origin, Chicano and Latino populations in the United States and the U.S.-Mexico transborder region.

programme_facts.value: The curriculum focuses on growing the next generation of critical thinkers and changemakers who work toward improving the lives of Latinos, strengthening Latino and transborder communities, and honoring transborder knowledge.
